common_arguments.text:
Summary of document_to_summarize.md:
- Event on Saturday, April 19, 9 a.m.–1 p.m., with rain backup Sunday.
- Volunteers split into 3 groups: south walkway beds, raised herb boxes, pollinator strip.
- Residents asked to bring reusable gloves and hand tools; HOA supplies compost, trash bags, and some gloves.
- Budget: $180 for spring event, covering compost, plants, gloves, and labels.
- Planting plan includes culinary herbs (rosemary, thyme, parsley, mint in containers only) and pollinator-friendly flowers (lavender, calendula, coneflower, native milkweed).
- Deferred plants: tomatoes, zucchini, ornamental grasses.
- Volunteer sign-up: 11 adults, 4 teens, 1 waitlist; need wheelbarrow operator.
- Safety: no power tools without pre-registration; children under 10 restricted to Group C area.
- Communication: reminder email April 16, day-of text thread, photo recap post-event.
- Open decisions: finalize volunteer list, rain day polling, nursery quote choice, and resident portal sync language approval.
- FAQ: no gardening experience needed, partial shifts allowed, allergy notifications requested, street parking only.
Please acknowledge when you have reviewed this summary.
